latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of web-search-feishu skill:

- Enables real-time web search via DashScope Qwen, optimized for Feishu.
- Supports both text-only (default) and image search modes based on user request.
- Offers flexible search options: turbo, deep, agent, think, fresh, and site-specific queries.
- Provides clear decision rules and usage examples for handling different types of user queries.
- Automatic image sending for visual requests; citation and reasoning support for text responses.
- Includes troubleshooting steps and strict guidelines to protect credentials.
